extracted.intended_audience: researchers based at eligible research organisations applying for Medical Research Council (MRC) / UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of MRC funding opportunities with eligibility rules, required application components, scope expectations, funding levels, and submission deadlines for specific calls (e.g., Experimental Medicine Stage One; UKRI metascience scientometrics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application must include an intervention in humans
rubrics_metrics.description: Your application must include an intervention in humans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a mandatory scope requirement for the 'Experimental medicine stage one' opportunity — proposed work should involve a human intervention rather than solely preclinical or in vitro work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant affiliation: researcher at eligible research organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be a researcher based at a research organisation eligible to apply for Medical Research Council (MRC) funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications will only be accepted from researchers whose employing/host organisations meet MRC eligibility; check MRC/UKRI eligibility guidance for which organisations qualify.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only requirement (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment call is not open to general application — only invited applicants may submit a proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope requirement — metascience scientometrics call
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should address development/validation/critique of new scientometric indicators specifically for research assessment and metascience; align proposal objectives with this stated scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding level and cost basis (UKRI metascience)
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to �������������3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget planning should reflect the expectation of awards up to ��������������3 million and that fundable costs will be reimbursed at 80% FEC; check call-specific guidance for exact costing rules and allowable costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call timeline: publication, opening and closing dates & times
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding opportunity has specific publication, opening and closing dates and times (e.g., Experimental medicine stage one: Publication date 30 April 2026; Opening date 30 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date 7 October 2026 4:00pm UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted within the stated window; late submissions will not be accepted. Note the precise closing time and time zone (UK time) and plan institutional approvals and submission checks accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders and co-funders: acknowledgement of participating councils
rubrics_metrics.description: Some opportunities are funded or co-funded by multiple UKRI councils and departmental partners (e.g., UKRI metascience scientometrics lists UKRI, ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC and co-funder DSIT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be aware of multi-council priorities and any cross-council expectations; consult the call text for any funder-specific requirements or thematic priorities.
